summary: Toy p-values with zero exceedances were reported as p = 0 with error 0 instead of an upper bound.

database_specific.introduced_basis: the defective lines are in the repository's first commit, the 0.3.0 import; earlier releases are not in this repository

observables: toy p-values and their binomial errors (likelihood_limits.py toy significances, statistical_toys.py)
impact.bias: with no toy beyond the observed statistic the p-value was 0 with error 0, which overstates the significance without limit; it is now the bound 1 - 0.05^(1/N) for N toys
impact.trigger: a toy-based p-value where no toy reached the observed test statistic (a strong excess or too few toys)

remedy: recompute the toy p-value with a release that has the fix (0.6.11 or later); a zero becomes an upper bound, so run more toys if a value is needed
